_about: Which Mixamo download plays for each of the app's moves (js/aikit.js), and how it is fitted to the fight board's clock. 'map' is a list of [seconds into the app's move, frame of the Mixamo file]: the frames between are played evenly. The blow must land where the board expects it: 0.72 s for close attacks, 1.05 s for a shot, 0.96 s for magic; a hit lands at 0.2 s, a block or dodge meets the blow at 0.33 s. 'drift' says what to do with a move that walks off its spot: 'ramp' takes out the steady travel so it ends where it began, 'strip' takes out all forward travel (walking on the spot), 'back' lets it go a little way and brings it home, 'keep' lets it go a little way and stay (falling down).
